summary: RAG + embedding coverage-repair swap + focused FM patch
hypothesis: Moving coverage judgment out of the 3B entirely — using deterministic NLEmbedding in Swift to detect the least-covered gold unknown and swap the most-redundant draft slot — should be a surgical, low-risk patch that can't mangle the rest of the draft.
technique: Build exp003's RAG draft (6/7 questions untouched), then in Swift use NLEmbedding to find the gold question (from the 2 nearest exemplars) whose unknown is least covered, identify the most-redundant draft slot, and make one focused FM call to adapt that gold question into the redundant slot — all coverage judgment is deterministic, only the single patch call uses the model.
result: Scored 0.213 on dev-10 (0 wins / 0 ties / 10 losses vs Sonnet), down −0.107 from the exp003 best of 0.320 and −0.094 vs baseline — the worst RAG variant yet, discarded. The repair call produced near/exact duplicates of already-present draft questions in ~8/10 cases, tanking nonRed from 4 to 2, while coverage stayed at 3 — the embedding gap-detector mis-targeted niche dimensions, and the one-shot FM patch call regenerated content it already had, confirming that deterministic embedding similarity is too blunt to identify decision-critical unknowns.

stages.text: Fetch 2 nearest gold exemplars via RAG
NLEmbedding: find least-covered gold unknown & most-redundant slot
One FM call adapts gold Q into redundant slot
